meta.title: Pricing — EcolnaSpace | An offer tailored to your establishment
meta.description: What determines EcolnaSpace pricing: establishment size, number of campuses, modules and support. Free organization setup and a tailored quote.

hero.title: You only pay for what your establishment actually needs
hero.lead: A neighborhood school and a multi-campus group don't have the same needs. Pricing depends on size, sites, enabled modules, and support — not a one-size-fits-all grid.
hero.note: Free organization setup, no credit card required.

factors.title: Four criteria, fully transparent
factors.body: No hidden fees and no features locked behind arbitrary tiers. Here is exactly what our advisors take into account when preparing your quote.

size.title: Establishment size
size.body: The number of enrolled students or children comes first: it reflects how much the platform is actually used.
size.example: From a school with a few dozen students to a network of several hundred.

campuses.title: Number of campuses
campuses.body: Every site is managed within the same organization, with its own access rights and a consolidated view for leadership.
campuses.example: A single site, or several campuses under one leadership team.

modules.title: Enabled modules
modules.body: You only enable the modules you need: core management and academic tracking.
modules.example: A tutoring center may skip report cards; a high school will enable exams and grades.

support.title: Level of support
support.body: Onboarding, importing your existing data, training your team: support is scaled to your needs.
support.example: Self-guided setup or full support for your team.

modules.title: Build the platform that fits you
modules.body: Every establishment starts from the same core. Specialized modules are added to match your activity, and can be switched on or off at any time.

core.title: Core management
core.body: Everything you need to run your establishment day to day.
features: Announcements, messages and notifications to families
Separate access for leadership, teachers, staff and parents
core.fit: The foundation of every EcolnaSpace organization.

academic.title: Academic tracking
academic.body: Academic follow-up, right where teachers already work.
academic.fit: Built for primary, middle, high school, multi-level garderie, tutoring, and training.

included.title: What every establishment gets, whatever the offer
included.body: Some commitments are not up for negotiation. They are part of every EcolnaSpace organization from day one.

languages.title: French, English and Arabic
languages.body: A complete interface in all three languages, with a right-to-left layout for Arabic.

isolation.title: Data isolated per establishment
isolation.body: Your organization's data is never mixed with another customer's.

roles.title: Role-based access
roles.body: Each profile only sees what concerns them; medical information is limited to authorized roles.

hosting.title: Hosted in Tunisia
hosting.body: Your data is hosted on servers located in Tunisia.

updates.title: Continuous updates
updates.body: Platform improvements roll out to everyone, at no extra cost and with no migration.

support.title: A real person to talk to
support.body: A team you can reach by email to answer your questions and help you along.

start.title: Get started right away
start.body: Creating your organization is free and requires no credit card. Explore the platform at your own pace, then talk to an advisor to define the right offer.

process.title: A clear quote in three steps

one.title: You describe your establishment
one.body: Through the contact form: type of establishment, number of students, campuses and main needs.

two.title: We talk it through
two.body: An advisor gets back to you to clarify your needs and, if you wish, walk you through the platform.

three.title: You receive a written proposal
three.body: A detailed quote, module by module, with no hidden fees, that you can review at your own pace.

calculation.a: Pricing is based on four criteria: the number of enrolled students, the number of campuses, the modules enabled and the level of support you want. Your quote itemizes each of them, so you know exactly what you are paying for.

setupFees.a: Creating your organization is free. If you want specific support — importing your existing data or training your team — any cost is clearly stated in the quote before you commit. Nothing is ever charged without being announced first.

tryFirst.q: Can I try the platform before committing?
tryFirst.a: Yes. You can create your organization for free, with no credit card, and explore the interface with your team. Commercial terms are then agreed with an advisor, based on your setup.

changePlan.q: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.a: Yes. Modules are switched on and off per organization: you can add a campus or enable academic tracking as you grow. Your advisor then adjusts your plan.

commitment.a: The commitment period depends on your setup and is stated explicitly in your quote. Our advisors walk you through the available options during your conversation, so you can decide with full information.

dataOnExit.q: What happens to our data if we leave?
dataOnExit.a: Your data belongs to you. At the end of the contract, you have a period to export it, after which it is deleted as described in our <link>Terms of Service</link>.

quoteDelay.q: How long does it take to get a quote?
quoteDelay.a: We answer every request as quickly as we can, usually within a few business days. The more precise your request (number of students, campuses, modules you want), the more precise our proposal.

final.title: Let's talk about your establishment
final.body: Tell us about your establishment in a few lines: we'll propose a tailored offer, with no obligation.
